name: workspace.recent
title: List recent workspaces
summary: The workspaces the app opened last, the most recent first (at most 20): the root of each, when it was opened, and whether the root still holds reqseq-workspace.yaml. The list belongs to the user, not to a workspace, so every access gives the same list from any folder.

root.description: The absolute path of the workspace root as the app opened it last (the folder that holds reqseq-workspace.yaml).

opened.description: When the app opened it last.

exists.description: Whether `<root>/reqseq-workspace.yaml` is a file now: the root itself, never a folder above it. A root without an answer within 1 s (a share that does not answer) counts as false; while earlier checks of this process still hang (a long-running API or MCP server), every root may count as false.

workspaces.description: The workspaces the app opened last, the most recent first, as the app's utility process that runs `@reqseq/core` recorded them in `<OS cache>/reqseq/recent-workspaces.json` (ADR-0008). Empty when none is recorded or the list cannot be read. Only the app records; the command line, the API and the MCP server only read the list.
